name: Nemotron-H-8B-Base-8K
activation: relu2 (mlp_hidden_act); silu in the Mamba path
attention_variant: GQA on 4 of 52 layers; Mamba-2 on 48
license: NVIDIA Internal Scientific Research and Development Model License (license:other)
notes: Hybrid confirmed from config plus weights. config.json hybrid_override_pattern is 'M-M-M-M*-M-M-M-M-M*-' repeated over 52 layers: 13 groups of 4, four of them starred as attention layers. The safetensors index agrees exactly - q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/o_proj appear for 4 of 52 layers, and the other 48 carry Mamba-2 mixer tensors (A_log, D, conv1d, dt_bias, in_proj, norm, out_proj). KV: bf16 bytes/token = 4 attention layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim (attention_head_dim, explicit) x 2 x 2 bytes = 16384 B/token = 16.0 KiB/token - 8x smaller than a 32-layer 8B dense GQA model at equal context. Recurrent state: ssm_state_size 128 x mamba_head_dim 64 x mamba_num_heads 128 x 2 bytes = 2 MiB per layer per sequence, x 48 layers = 96 MiB per sequence, constant in context length - that fixed 96 MiB is the real cost of this architecture and it scales with concurrency, not with context. gqa_ratio = 32 / 8 = 4. max_position_embeddings 8192 (the '-8K' in the name) with no rope_scaling; this model is about constant-state serving, not long context. intermediate_size 21504 with mlp_hidden_act 'relu2' (a squared-ReLU MLP), n_groups 8, mamba_num_heads 128, time_step_rank 256. rescale_prenorm_residual true.
